description.zh:
要锁定的用户所在堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the users to be locked belong.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
指定要锁定的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the users to be locked belong.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
要锁定的用户ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持添加100个用户ID，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
> 您可以调用[ListUsers](~~204522~~)接口获取用户ID。
description.en:
The ID of the user to be locked. The value is a JSON string. You can add up to 100 user IDs. If you specify multiple IDs, separate the IDs with commas (,).

> You can call the [ListUsers](~~204522~~) operation to query the ID of the user.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于批量锁定堡垒机用户。如果某个用户在一段时间内无需使用堡垒机进行运维操作，您可以使用本接口锁定该用户，被锁定的用户将无法登录服务器进行运维操作。如果后续需要解锁该用户，您可使用[UnlockUsers](~~204590~~)接口来解锁。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
# Description

Locks one or more bastion host users to prevent them from performing O\&M operations. If a user does not need to use a bastion host within a specific period of time, lock the user account. Locked users cannot log on to or perform O\&M operations on the hosts on which they have permissions. To unlock users later, use the [UnlockUsers](~~204590~~) operation.

# Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost lock-users --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
